The text you ask to hear is sent only to the source you choose for phrases, examples, previews and read-aloud narration. Microsoft Read Aloud and Baidu Translate are free and key-free, unofficial and unlicensed, and neither is guaranteed to stay available; Baidu has one English voice, so it cannot honour the US or UK choice. Android system speech uses the device\'s speech engine, not the Microsoft or Baidu services; that engine may use a network voice. Narration also sends upcoming paragraphs to prepare audio. AI credentials are not sent. A single word still tries Youdao Dictionary\'s recording first, then the two speech services, with installed system speech last.
